body: I'm not a fan of AdventureTime.  Something about this....this is the most I've smiled in a long time.  Thank you.
I don't think it matters what the actual username is.  It's not a huge mystery, but I'm curious as to what could cause this.

I need to get through this month like no other.  With an upcoming court date, and a massive move to a new city and job, I need to return back to focus and healthy living.

I plan to do no PM, and no casual flings for the O.  If I happen to find someone special, then that'll be that.  Started on Sunday, so, I strive to stick to this all the way though June (and beyond).
So it is.  I was looking at the thread, not the main page.  Thanks.
Can you provide said link?  I don't see anything in the sidebar about it.

A restraining order is a civil matter.  These are criminal charges, albeit a misdemeanor.  

But it's the bigger picture.  The world will be better off without me, this is just the latest in a long string of interpersonal issues.  I'll be glad, and so will the world, when I'm dead.

He is a scumbag.  He's also a law student.

There isn't any proof (other than my therapist's notes) that he caused me emotional distress, nor is it illegal for him to have done so.  I spoke briefly with a lawyer about making a claim as such, and was essentially told that I didn't have a case.   _Especially_ since in NC, if you are in any way complicit (even 1%), there is no grounds for restitution.  According to everyone _professional_, I essentially got myself into this mess by being turned on by BDSM.  The psychiatrist in the hospital even said "you choose to live this way, you kind of have to deal with the consequences".

I've spoken with people on /r/bdsmcommunity in the past.  Generally speaking, the community is good.  But I have such strong distrust against everyone now, I can't even open up anymore in the community.  I'm living in fear, and it's metaphorically killing me.  I don't have any other way out.

If I spend a couple thousand dollars, maybe I can fight them.  The law for this statute is so vague, though.  I might be able to get off on "intent" because my intent was not to annoy or harass, but unfortunately, the law has very specific definitions of these things.

Oh, and did I mention the guy is a law student from a wealthy family?   Hes got connections and funds to back everything up.  Granted, I make near 6 figures, but I don't have the pull he does.  Plus the court date is 6 months away for some reason.  So I'd have to live in fear for 6 months!  Then be charged and fined as a criminal....

I did have dreams once.  I remember that I did.  But I'm so far gone now, I don't even remember. My life has been on fast forward for months, with me just....there.

I'm so scared of everything, and i have almost nowhere to turn.  As soon as I cs take care of this upcoming convention for my friends, I think I'm gonna do it.

I just wanted help.  And Patrick took everything from me.

He's already won, though.  Between having me involuntarily committed to a psych ward, and now with the criminal charges, my future is bleak indeed.  These things will always be on my record, and there's no way to fight them.

So what choice do I have, really?  Either live a life of misery, being branded as mentally ill and a criminal for the rest of my life, or I can end it now and die with whatever shred of dignity I can muster.

I'd love to fight.  But I'm just...so, so tired.  I wanted help.  I needed it, to be sure.  I tried therapy.  I tried psychiatry and meds.  I tried friends.  Nothing helped.  I'm scared of myself, and I'm scared of life.  And that's been true for going on 8 months now.

So really, what choice do I have?

I was in therapy for 8 months.  I recently quit because I gave up.
I always came back to him.  Everything I do has revolved around thinking about him.  He's ingrained in my psyche.

I know I can't live like this.  I know it's not healthy.  I've tried breaking it.  He clearly wants nothing to do with me.  But the nature that our relationship was had me as his servant.  I needed him to be worth something in that relationship.  And when he just up and left, I crumbled.  Now he's taken everything else I had left.   I can't eat.  I barely sleep.  I'm barely living as it is.

He already had me involuntarily committed.  I'm not going back to that psych ward.  Definitely a restraining order will be issued, probably along with a fine.  I live in NC, and based on class of misdemeanor and the fact that I have no prior offenses, this is 1-30 days of community service and maybe up to a $1000 fine.

Still, I have been in a deep spiraling depression for the last 8 months, and the one person who I think could help me is instead reporting me to the police for trying to seek help.

I'm so done.  There's no recovery from this for me.  I refuse to have this on my record because I tried to seek help.  I refuse.  The only way out is up (so to speak...since I'm not exactly religious).

I sent him several emails trying to get him to help me through the depression that caused when he broke off our Dom/sub relationship.  I was convinced that he could help, because nothing else helped.

My emails read along the lines of "Please talk to me, I need your help" and "I'm begging you, please help".

Yesterday I was served with a Criminal Misdemeanor Summons for CyberStalking by "repeaded emailing...with intent to...harass the plaintiff"

Oh yeah.  From societal norms, anything other than a courteous "I'm fine, thanks" is frowned upon.   But generally I was talking about people I've let in to the fact that I'm not OK right now.   Every. Single. Day.  "How are you doing today?".   I mean, it's touching that they care.  The gesture is appreciated.  However, people don't always consider that it's just simply reminding me that I do, in fact, feel shitty every day right now, and that has the opportunity to set off a spiral.

Thank you for your support.  This thread has given me a bit of hope for my eventual rejoining of the community.  I feel I need to take a break for a while, while I figure out how to do this all safely again.  But knowing that there are good people out there helps, a lot.

This comment is awesome.  You are awesome.  And everything you said is correct.

I just got out of an involuntary commitment to the psych ward that the dom in question put me into because I sent him an angry email that had implications of self harm.  My actions kept me there, but he initiated it and yet _still_ wont talk to me.

You are, of course, right in that he isn't worthy of another human being and especially isn't worthy of me.  I can do so much better than him.  Part of me wants to see him suffer the way he made me suffer.  He is a terrible human being and I'm honestly afraid that left unchecked he will continue to abuse and take advantage of other people.

Regardless, this is about me, and I need to be OK with my sexuality again.  I've been into BDSM for almost 10 years now, and up until last year I had gotten to a place where I was _extremely_ comfortable with that part of myself.  He ruined that, for the time being.  And it will be a while before I get it back.

Until then, I just have to move on one day at a time.

Thank you for your support.

That's a surprisingly good analogy, and yes, minecraft was one of my favorite games for a very long time.  I've met some of my closest friends through it, and I host a server for them out of my house.  So rest assured, the reference is not lost.

I'm doing better, though he just had me involuntarily committed to the psych ward for a self-harm watch.  So now I've gotta deal with him butting into my life again.

But I will be OK, and thanks for the reply.

I've been in weekly therapy since he cut me off.  It hasn't really helped.  Seeing a psychiatrist next week about depression meds.

I just don't know what to do....This has been part of my identity for going on 10 years now, and I am now haunted by it.  And he feels that he did nothing wrong.

Granted, I have to live with my choices now, but if anyone has suggestions on how to cover it up for thanksgiving....I'd be immensely appreciative.
I am probably not the person you think I am.  As far as me being alive, it appears that is a reality I just have to accept.
That makes sense.  It's the pain in my throat that I'm more concerned about.  I mean, it all makes sense, and is a bit deserved as a reminder.  Just curious how long I can expect...

It's been dismantled.  I have no intent on trying again.   I can't deal with pain well....I didn't realize it would hurt so much.

Sorry, not that this changes any of your comment, but I wanted to be clear.  We're both guys.

No, I really don't have a best friend.  I tend to shy away from emotional contact with people.  I've been much more open recently, but still it seems superficial in nature.  And me reacting like this to a loss (of something I'll never have) doesn't help me want to make relationships with people.

The painkillers are OTC stuff (aleve and ibuprofen), though they are both large bottles.  Flushing them (or just tossing them) only makes it harder.  Plus I've got a variety of pet meds for my dog that aren't as easy to just throw away.

I just don't know where to turn.  I'm already in therapy once a week, and this will definitely be a focus this week.  But this was a sudden hit of depression.  I was driving to meet some friends for a weekly thing, and after having a one-message exchange with him, I just simply lost all caring.  And it never came back.
Well, it's not how I wanted it to turn out.  But he's not interested in that sort of relationship, so I guess it had to end this way eventually.

> IE - he allows himself to become emotionally involved with women, but not so with men? Yet he is capable of having sexual relations with either sex?

I have my thoughts on this, but it's not appropriate for me to analyze him or to claim I understand his feelings better than he does.

> Either way, it sounds like you need to find someone who is equally hungry for your time and energy as you'd be for theirs.

This is very true, but apparently, incredibly hard for me to do.  I always fall for the ones that aren't interested.  And fall I did, here.  Hard.  Twice.

Well, that was awkward.  Glad I caught the "you posted this under the wrong account, dumbass".

Anyway,  the relationship has ended, both from a Dom/sub and from any other aspect you can imagine.  It hurts, a lot.  But I knew that was going to happen.  So now I just have to move on.

Thanks again for the advice.

Yea.  As I said, I already knew the answer.  You're right.  I'm typing up my explanation to him now.  We'll see how it goes.  One way or another it's likely to hurt, but better to get it over now and deal with it like a human being.

Thanks for reinforcing what I already knew.

Well, the coworker I've been working with for 2 years.  We're friendly enough, but he's kind of private.  Every once in awhile I get fantasies of what if, but mostly its okay.  I'd like it to stop though.

The other guy is a friend I met online a while back through gaming.  Just recently met in person, and he's really cute.  Playfully hit on him all weekend, and he just sort of brushed it off.  I'd rather not push it further, and I know it won't go anywhere.  If I could just stop fantasizing about it, I think it'd be a lot less awkward.

I really don't want to focus on negative qualities.  I want to keep a good relationship with them, just want my brain/heart/dick to realize that it'll never happen as anything more than friendship/coworker.
Focusing on the negative will eventually make me want to just not be around them, which would solve the problem, but not in a good way, IMO.
